beats.voice_sync_text: Welcome back students! Namukku Section 54G padikkam through Apex Engineering Ltd-inte case study. Apex Engineering Ltd urban corporation limit-il ninnu rural non-urban area-yilekku tanted industrial undertaking shift cheyyan decide cheythu. March 2026-il company 4 assets sell cheythu: Land, Building, Plant & Machinery, and Furniture. Athu pole July 2026-il new assets-um acquire cheythu. First golden rule step: Asset classification! Land, Building, and Plant & Machinery market value ulla industrial assets aanu. They are Eligible Specified Assets under Section 54G! Ennal Furniture & Fixtures non-specified asset aanu, athinukku Section 54G exemption kitilla!

beats.voice_sync_text: Ippo Section 54G Sub-section (1)-inte statutory mandate nokku. Statute clear aayi parayunnu: Capital Gain arise cheyyunnath transfer of Plant, Machinery, Land or Building used for industrial undertaking in an urban area aayirikkanam. And conditions fill cheyyan assesse new plant, machinery, land or building acquire cheyyendath 1 Year before OR 3 Years after the date of transfer aanu. Apex Engineering Ltd March 2026-il asset sell cheythu, July 2026-il new assets buy cheythu. This is well within the 3-year statutory window!

quote.text: Where the capital gain arises from the transfer of a capital asset, being plant, machinery, land or building... used for the purpose of an industrial undertaking situated in an urban area... and the assessee has within a period of one year before or three years after the date on which the transfer took place purchased new machinery or plant or acquired building or land...
quote.emphasis: plant, machinery, land or building... 1 year before or 3 years after

context_bubble.speaker: Section 54G(1)
context_bubble.text: Reinvestment Window: 1 Year Before or 3 Years After Transfer Date

beats.voice_sync_text: Next step, Apex Engineering Ltd buy cheytha new assets-inte Eligible Reinvestment Pool calculate cheyyam. New Land: Rs 5 Lakhs, New Building: Rs 8 Lakhs, New Plant & Machinery: Rs 16 Lakhs. Total eligible investment u/s 54G is Rs 29 Lakhs! Ennal new Furniture-il invest cheytha Rs 3 Lakhs completely exclude cheyyanam. Deemed Short-term Capital Gain u/s 50 target ceiling Rs 25 Lakhs aayathukond, ee Rs 29 Lakhs exemption completely cover cheyyan mathiyaayathaanu!

outcome.text: Eligible to Set-off against both STCG & LTCG

beats.voice_sync_text: Ippo Golden Optimization Trick manassilaakku! Income-tax Act-il Section 54G exemption pro-rata set-off cheyyanam ennu niyamam illa. Assessee-kku most beneficial manner-il set-off cheyyam. Short-term Capital Gain normal slab rate-il 30% tax aayapol, Land LTCG Section 112 prakaram 12.5% tax aanu. So, Section 54G exemption of Rs 29 Lakhs-il ninnu aadyam Rs 25 Lakhs Short-term Capital Gain fully wipe out cheyyanam! Net STCG on industrial assets becomes Nil! Balance Rs 4 Lakhs exemption Land-inte Rs 5 Lakhs LTCG-yude ethire set-off cheyyanam. Balance Taxable LTCG is Rs 1 Lakh taxable @ 12.5%. Plus, Furniture STCG of Rs 1 Lakh is fully taxable. Total Taxable Capital Gain is Rs 2 Lakhs!

beats.voice_sync_text: CA Final exam-il Section 54G problem solve cheyyumbol ee 3 Golden Rules nannayi orthekkuk. Rule 1: Furniture strict basket out aanu, transfer-ilum reinvestment-ilum qualify cheyyilla. Rule 2: Section 50 deemed STCG aayal polum Section 54G exemption fully available aanu. Rule 3: Tax liability minimize cheyyan exemption first 30% STCG-kk ethire set-off cheyyanam, balance LTCG-kk ethire. Clear aayille? All the best!

title.text: 3 Golden Rules for Section 54G Exam Mastery

rules.heading: Strict Asset Basket (Furniture Excluded)
rules.body: Furniture-nu Section 54G-il sthanamilla. Neither transfer nor reinvestment in Furniture qualifies.

rules.heading: Section 50 Deemed STCG is Fully Eligible
rules.body: Section 50 prakaram depreciable assets STCG aayal polum, Section 54G exemption valid aanu.

rules.heading: Most Beneficial Set-Off Priority
rules.body: Tax liability minimize cheyyan deduction aadyam 30% STCG-kk ethireyum, balance 12.5% LTCG-kk ethireyum set-off cheyyam!
